description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Reads every cell of a table (JSON rows or CSV, up to 20000 rows) and reports per column: type (integer, decimal, date, boolean, text, mixed), filled and blank counts, distinct values, most common values, number sum/min/max (exact), date range, and whether it is unique (a possible id). Lists the problems that break later steps: numbers written with $ or commas, mixed date formats, ambiguous slash dates, stray spaces, the same value in different capitalisation, and duplicate rows (with row numbers). Use it before table_calc or table_join on data you have not seen.
name: table_profile
title: Profile a spreadsheet: what every column holds and what is wrong with it
